messages.subject: Generate Download csv with shiny
parts:

##server
function(input,output) { data <- reactive({
  file1 <- input$file
  if(is.null(file1)){return()} 
  read.table(file=file1$datapath, sep=input$sep, header = input$header, stringsAsFactors = input$stringAsFactors)
  
})


output$table <- renderTable({
  if(is.null(data())){return ()}
  data()
})
output$tb1 <- renderUI({
  tableOutput("table")    
})

output$modelselect<-renderUI({
  selectInput("modelselect","Select Algo",choices = c("Logistic_reg"="Log","Naives_Bayes"="n","Decision Tree"= "dec"),selected = "Log")
})

output$modelselect2<-renderUI({
  selectInput("modelselect2","Select Algo",choices = c("Logistic_reg"="Log2","Naives_Bayes"="n2","Decision Tree"= "dec2"),selected = "Log")
})
output$employees<-renderUI({
  sliderInput("employees","Select Number of employees",min=1,max= 300,value = 300,step=1)
})

output$tb2 <- renderDataTable({
  if(input$modelselect2== "Log2"){
    f1<-data()

    hr_model1$left <- as.factor(hr_model1$left)
    train_control<- trainControl(method="cv", number=5, repeats=3)
    # Keep some data to test again the final model
    inTraining <- createDataPartition(hr_model1$left, p = .75, list = FALSE)
    training <- hr_model1[ inTraining,]
    testing  <- hr_model1[-inTraining,]

    predattrition$priority=predattrition$performance*predattrition$probaToLeave

    orderpredattrition <- head(orderpredattrition, n=input$employees)
    or<- data.frame(orderpredattrition)
    or
}

output$other_val_show<-renderPrint({
  if(input$modelselect== "Log"){
  f<-data()
  hr_model <- f %>% filter(last_evaluation >= 0.70 | time_spend_company >= 4 | number_project > 5)
  hr_model$left <- as.factor(hr_model$left)
  train_control<- trainControl(method="cv", number=5, repeats=3)
  
  
  gmlmodel <- train(left~., data=hr_model, trControl=train_control, method="LogitBoost")
  # make predictions
  predictions<- predict(gmlmodel,hr_model)
  gmlmodelbinded <- cbind(hr_model,predictions)
  # summarize results
  confusionMatrix<- confusionMatrix(gmlmodelbinded$predictions,gmlmodelbinded$left)
  confusionMatrix }})

     #summarize results

    confusionMatrix
  }})
  
  
  output$other_val_show3<-renderPrint({

    f<-data()

    train_control<- trainControl(method="cv", number=5, repeats=3)

    # make predictions

    confusionMatrix
  }})
  
  output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { paste(input$modelselect2,input$employees, '.csv', sep='') },

    }
